disease: Mucopolysaccharidosis type I (alpha-L-iduronidase deficiency; Hurler / Hurler-Scheie / Scheie syndrome; MPS I)

emergence.disease: Mucopolysaccharidosis type I (alpha-L-iduronidase deficiency; Hurler / Hurler-Scheie / Scheie syndrome; MPS I)
emergence.summary: IDUA encodes the lysosomal exoglycosidase alpha-L-iduronidase, which removes terminal alpha-L-iduronic-acid residues during the stepwise degradation of the glycosaminoglycans DERMATAN SULFATE and HEPARAN SULFATE. Loss-of-function halts that catabolic step -> progressive lysosomal GAG accumulation across many tissues: dysostosis multiplex, corneal clouding, hepatosplenomegaly, cardiac valve disease, airway disease, and -- in severe Hurler -- progressive neurocognitive decline. Lysosomal GAG-catabolism axis DOWN.

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: alpha-L-iduronidase hydrolyses terminal alpha-L-iduronic acid on dermatan/heparan sulfate; LOF blocks GAG degradation -> lysosomal storage. Severe null alleles (e.g. p.Trp402Ter, p.Gln70Ter -- common in northern-European Hurler) abolish activity (Hurler); attenuated alleles retain residual activity (Hurler-Scheie / Scheie). The classic catabolic-enzyme deficiency-with-substrate-accumulation shape.
per_gene.src: Scott 1991 PNAS 88:9695 (IDUA cloning); Neufeld & Muenzer 2001 (MMBID, MPS overview)

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

treatment_A_switch.disease: Mucopolysaccharidosis type I (alpha-L-iduronidase deficiency; Hurler / Hurler-Scheie / Scheie syndrome; MPS I)

levers.push_direction: supply functional alpha-L-iduronidase to RESTORE the deficient lysosomal GAG-degradation step (raise the catabolic throughput back toward normal) -> reduced somatic dermatan/heparan-sulfate storage; net axis effect UP toward function (DIRECT, on the causal enzyme).
levers.agent_class: enzyme replacement therapy (laronidase, recombinant human alpha-L-iduronidase)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] substrate-clearance fraction / dose / infusion regimen not asserted. Approved (laronidase / Aldurazyme) for the non-CNS manifestations of MPS I. IMPORTANT honest limit: the recombinant enzyme does NOT cross the blood-brain barrier, so the CNS / neurocognitive disease of severe Hurler is NOT addressed by systemic ERT -- a documented gap, magnitude/CNS-reach [O].
levers.src: Wraith 2004 J Pediatr 144:581 (laronidase phase 3); Aldurazyme FDA 2003

levers.push_direction: restore endogenous alpha-L-iduronidase by haematopoietic reconstitution: enzyme-secreting donor-derived cells cross-correct host tissues, and (unlike systemic ERT) engrafted donor microglia provide some CNS enzyme when given early in severe Hurler -> durable somatic and partial CNS GAG clearance; net axis effect UP.
levers.agent_class: allogeneic haematopoietic stem-cell transplantation (HSCT; standard of care for early severe Hurler) + ex-vivo autologous IDUA gene-corrected HSC therapy (investigational)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] engraftment, enzyme level and the degree/timing of CNS protection are clinical outcomes not derived from sequence; HSCT is established standard for early severe MPS I but is a procedure with its own risks, not a drug approval, and its CNS benefit is partial and age-dependent -- [O].

lead_corrective_lever.mechanism_grade: [O] substrate-clearance fraction / dose / infusion regimen not asserted. Approved (laronidase / Aldurazyme) for the non-CNS manifestations of MPS I. IMPORTANT honest limit: the recombinant enzyme does NOT cross the blood-brain barrier, so the CNS / neurocognitive disease of severe Hurler is NOT addressed by systemic ERT -- a documented gap, magnitude/CNS-reach [O].
lead_corrective_lever.src: Wraith 2004 J Pediatr 144:581 (laronidase phase 3); Aldurazyme FDA 2003

modelling.grade: [F] ordering forced ; delta/treat_frac documented choices ; realised magnitude [O]

treatment_A_switch.firewall: levers are DIRECTION + cited agent CLASS; not dose/potency/efficacy/safety, not a recommendation to treat any individual.

falsifiers.claim: IDUA loss-of-function moves the lysosomal GAG-catabolism axis DOWN (dermatan/heparan-sulfate accumulate)
falsifiers.falsifier: an IDUA LOF allele that LOWERS tissue / urinary GAG (i.e. raises catabolic throughput) refutes the axis-DOWN direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: leukocyte/fibroblast alpha-L-iduronidase activity and urinary dermatan/heparan-sulfate GAG quantification, stratified by IDUA genotype

falsifiers.claim: enzyme replacement is the CORRECTIVE direction (raises the deficient catabolic throughput)
falsifiers.falsifier: if laronidase raised rather than reduced tissue/urinary GAG storage the 'replace' lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: urinary GAG and liver/spleen-volume response to laronidase infusion

gate_falsifiers.gate: falsifier register (>=1 measurable falsifier per disease)
